# demo/enrich

A built-in enrich adapter for person records: it needs any of `email` or `full_name` and provides 2 fields. Plan estimates $0.0100 per record, and it demands no credential.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `demo/enrich` |
| version | 1 |
| role | enrich |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | none |
| cost estimate per record | $0.0100 |
| freshness | 30 days (the default `cache:` window) |

## Needs

```json
{
  "anyOf": [
    {
      "required": [
        "email"
      ]
    },
    {
      "required": [
        "full_name"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "properties": {
    "email": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "full_name": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Provides

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "demo.note": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "demo.score": {
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cost_per_record_usd` | number |  | The pretend price of one enrichment, for the receipt's arithmetic (default 0.01) |

## Example

From [A pipeline is a YAML file](/concepts/pipeline):

```yaml
  - id: score
    use: demo/enrich            # $0.01 per record, pretend; cached for 30 days
    with:
      cost_per_record_usd: 0.01
```
